description: This week’s cash leaders from audited SEC filings: the top 20 US companies ($2B+) by cash returned to owners (dividends + net buybacks ÷ market value), by operating cash earned ÷ market value, and by expected return among steady earners (income yield + Edgarette’s 80% revenue range). Also short-term places (Treasury-bill, floating-rate and ultra-short funds from their N-PORT filings: monthly returns, worst month, holdings mix) and monthly dividend payers (10-K verified, with yield, coverage, leverage, book value change, dividend cuts and warning signs). Every company passes a soundness screen first: no warning filing in 12 months, assets greater than liabilities, 4+ audited years. Ranked screens, not recommendations; prices are the latest quarter-end 13F prices.
name: get_cash_leaders
